metric: sites building a movement covariate by EDGE-COUNTING one rotary-encoder line
command: git grep -n Rot_enc -- src scripts tests
notes: The TF-GLM's wheel covariate is Rot_enc_A tick DENSITY (ticks/bin) - ONE line of a two-line quadrature encoder, unsigned and undecoded, so it cannot separate travel from dither and cannot see direction at all (the B line carries the sign and is never read). MAGNITUDE, CORRECTED: an earlier draft of the spec claimed ~6x gross/net inflation; its audit found that to be a divide-by-small-denominator artefact of quiet windows and gives the SESSION-WIDE ratio as 1.25x (s3). Cite 1.25x, note it is larger in quiet windows, do NOT cite 6x. Also retracted: '100% transition validity' is a TAUTOLOGY (a threshold extractor emits strictly alternating rise/fall per line, so any one-bit Gray change is +/-1; the test returns 100% for pure noise). The informative test is whether consecutive transitions alternate BETWEEN lines: 5.3% do not, so honest validity is 94.7%. Decoding remains the correct method. Both lines are ALREADY in the pkls (probe of 01072025: Rot_enc_A n=226405, Rot_enc_B n=226758), so the fix needs no re-ingest. Wheel calibration is BRACKETED not point-identified: T=16 -> 0.156 mm/count, range [0.139, 0.167], +/-9% (s8) - do not quote 4 significant figures. Register entry A13. [corrected 2026-08-15 against the six-reviewer audited revision of docs/raw_data/NIDAQ_AND_EVENT_SPEC.md]
